cleanup.guest: python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove hang >/dev/null ; python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent remove junk >/dev/null ; true

description: D31: an agent whose incus is a stand-in that never exits, and one whose incus prints garbage; each call ends in a typed error and the agent keeps serving.

inputs.agent: transient Rust agents of the installed release candidate (0.3.0) under /tmp/e2e-agents

requirements.requirement: A failing provider command ends the call, not the agent
requirements.scenario: Hanging command: list_vms ends in a typed error within the 45 s discovery timeout, and the next call is served (D31)

requirements.requirement: A failing provider command ends the call, not the agent
requirements.scenario: Garbage output: list_vms and get_vm_info end in typed errors, and the next call is served (D31)

steps.guest: mkdir -p /tmp/e2e-agents/stubs && python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py stub /tmp/e2e-agents/stubs/incus-hang hang >/dev/null && python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py stub /tmp/e2e-agents/stubs/incus-junk garbage >/dev/null && chmod 755 /tmp/e2e-agents/stubs && echo ready

python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start hang --port 3043 --id e2e-hang-agent --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:hang} --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true --env OPUTE_INCUS_BINARY_PATH=/tmp/e2e-agents/stubs/incus-hang

python3 /opt/opute-e2e/guest/e2etool.py agent start junk --port 3044 --id e2e-junk-agent --env MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=${SECRET:junk} --env OPUTE_STANDALONE_ALLOW_MUTATIONS=true --env OPUTE_INCUS_BINARY_PATH=/tmp/e2e-agents/stubs/incus-junk
